description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the LeavePeriodDao class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system, specifically testing functionalities related to leave period history management, entitlement adjustments upon leave period changes, and retrieving leave period data.

classes.name: LeavePeriodDaoTest
classes.description: A test class for the LeavePeriodDao, covering saving leave period history, retrieving current leave periods, and handling entitlement adjustments on leave period changes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LeavePeriodDao instance and populates test data before each test method execution.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistoryFirstTime
methods.description: Tests saving a leave period history entry when no previous record exists, ensuring it sets the start date and clears entitlement strategies appropriately.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistory
methods.description: Tests updating the leave period history when a current record exists, including handling entitlement strategy invocation.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistoryWithTransactionException
methods.description: Verifies that a transaction exception is properly thrown and handled when an error occurs during leave period history save.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Checks retrieval of the current leave period's start date and month.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Validates retrieval of the list of leave period history entries in expected order.

methods.name: testEntitlementChangeWhenLeavePeriodChanged
methods.description: Simulates changing the leave period and verifies that employee entitlements are correctly adjusted for the new period, including previous and future periods.
